desc:
A classic cookie baking mix containing one 17.5‑ounce pouch. It’s part of America’s #1-rated cookie mix lineup, ideal for baking oatmeal cookies quickly at home target.com+5bettycrocker.com+5walmart.com+5.

Made for convenience: “Just mix, drop, and bake” for soft‑and‑chewy homemade-style cookies in mere minutes
features:
1. Quick & Convenient

Just mix, drop, and bake — Perfect for fast, homemade-style cookies anytime .

Uses simple ingredients: butter (or oil), water, and an egg — no special tools required.

2. Delicious Texture & Flavor

Soft, chewy oatmeal goodness with a hint of cinnamon — comfort in every bite .

Highly rated by customers: “perfect raisin oatmeal cookies,” “moist with cinnamon flavor,” “as good as homemade” .

3. Recipe Versatility

Enjoy as-is, or easily customize with add-ins like raisins, craisins, nuts, or chocolate chips — users routinely personalize and love the results .

4. Trusted Brand & Quality

From Betty Crocker, a trusted name in baking with over a century of expertise .

Recognized as America’s top cookie mix, based on Nielsen data (year ending June 1, 2024) .

5. Allergen & Nutrition Info

Contains wheat and milk; may contain soy and egg .

Nutrition per 2.5 Tbsp mix (23 g): ~90 cal, 1 g fat, 85 mg sodium, 18 g carbs (9 g sugar), 1 g protein .
ingredients:
Ingredients

Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Brown Sugar, Peanut Butter (peanuts, dextrose, hydrogenated canola and cottonseed oil, salt), Palm Oil, Baking Soda, Salt, Nonfat Milk.
